summary: Iter 21 per-mission verification tested end-to-end. Backend: 23/23 iter21 tests PASS (1 skipped for coparent). Frontend: all data-testids present, VerificationGateModal renders PIN / photo / async panels, mission-pending-review success screen shows after async submit, verify badges render on student dashboard, PendingReviewsPanel renders on parent dashboard, verify-pin section on Account page works, MissionForm has 4 verification option cards + conditional auto_approve_hours input.

minor.issue: Pre-existing regression unrelated to Iter 21: only 1 article slug ('chadd-school-routines') seen instead of >=11 expected. Not caused by verification changes.

ui_bugs.issue: Missions with 0 steps can never be completed because `allStepsDone` requires `steps.length > 0`. Pre-existing but blocks any user creating a step-less mission (including AI-drafted or 'quick' ones).

action_items: Consider fixing allStepsDone logic so 0-step missions can complete (change `steps.length > 0 && ...` to `steps.length === 0 || steps.every(...)`). Pre-existing but likely to bite users of new verification-only missions with no explicit steps.
Look at article rotation logic — only one article slug is being surfaced consistently.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 4701 lines — should be split into modules (auth, missions, logs, verification, digest, scheduler).
_MAX_PHOTO_BYTES is 2.5MB despite user-facing message and problem statement quoting 2MB. Consider lowering to 2_000_000 or updating the copy for consistency.

photo `content_type` defaults to 'image/jpeg' for raw base64 (no data URL) — no header sniffing / magic-byte validation. Server currently trusts client. Consider decoding first bytes to confirm actual image type.

Auto-approve tick is duplicated between server.py and the test file. Would be cleaner to extract into a callable function (e.g., `run_auto_approve_once()`) that both the scheduler and admin/test endpoints could invoke.
GET /api/logs/{log_id}/photo has no HTTP cache headers — every parent load will re-transfer full binary. Add ETag or Cache-Control since photos are immutable.

rca of the issue: For the 0-step-mission finish bug: `const allStepsDone = mission && mission.steps.length > 0 && mission.steps.every(...)` in /app/frontend/src/pages/MissionDetail.jsx line 96. When steps is [] the expression is false forever.
